model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE 
    ST_Within(geometry::geometry, regions.geometry::geometry)
    AND parks.leisure = 'nature_reserve'
    AND parks.tourism IS NULL
    AND regions.region_name = 'Franklin Township'
    AND regions.addr_county = 'Butler County'
    AND regions.addr_state = 'Pennsylvania'
),
max_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry
  FROM nature_reserve
  ORDER BY ST_Area(geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, true, max_reserve.geometry::geometry) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  JOIN max_reserve ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, max_reserve.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  max_reserve.id AS reserve_id,
  max_reserve.geometry AS reserve_geometry,
  MAX((clipped_rast).val) AS max_elevation
FROM max_reserve, clipped_dem;
```
